Senior Autonomy Stack Integration Engineer - Land Domain (m/f/d)
text:
Join Quantum Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As a Senior Autonomy Stack Integration Engineer in the Land Domain, you will ensure proper end-to-end functionality of our products across the whole autonomy stack. You will have a unique overview and understanding of details of all interacting components and work with the teams to make sure that component integration, tooling, and verification are innate to our development processes and that broader stack changes are exercised swiftly and with minimal friction.

You will work at the intersection of the autonomy software stack, vehicle manufacturers, and our SW Factory, making sure our vehicle controls are robust, safe, and reliably deployable.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead by example with excellent engineering practices within your team as well as all other land domain teams

  • Ensure that component teams can integrate their components safely and easily as much as possible and enable component team ownership after integration.

  • Set priorities, ensure delivery of high-quality engineer, and establish best practices for specification, development, testing, and review for both your team and the component teams you work with.

  • Be responsible for the end-to-end integration of the autonomy stack on our ground vehicle platforms, from individual software components to a functioning autonomous system.

  • Establish and maintain a deep understanding of the interfaces, dependencies, timing, data flows, and failure modes across the autonomy stack.

  • Own system-level troubleshooting and triaging, identify issues across component boundaries, and work with the responsible teams to drive them to resolution.

  • Build and maintain the tooling required to inspect, diagnose, reproduce, and understand system behavior across the complete autonomy stack.

  • Define and maintain representative integration environments, configurations, datasets, scenarios, and system-level tests.

  • Ensure integration on the vehicles and drive issues to resolution: strong troubleshooting, triaging, and integration discipline.

  • Apply robust software development practices across all parts of the stack the team is responsible for.

  • Build and run VnV setups for any changes your team exposes on the autonomy stack, from bench and rig testing to vehicle-level testing.

  • Establish automated testing and deployment in strong alignment with the SW Factory (target CI).

  • Treat safety and security as first-class requirements throughout development and integration.

  • Work hand-in-hand with Perception, Motion Planning & Control, Pilot, vehicle platform, SW Factory, Verification & Validation, and ground operations teams.

title: Senior Manager Business Ethics, Speak-up & Investigations (m/f/d)
text:
At Quantum Systems, we develop advanced autonomous systems for defense and security across multiple domains, combining unmanned platforms with integrated software and AI. As Senior Manager Business Ethics, Speak-up & Investigations, you will play a key role in building and strengthening Quantum Systems’ Group Ethics & Compliance programme. You will take end-to-end functional ownership for Business Ethics, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Speak-up and Internal Investigations.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with clear functional ownership and no direct people-management responsibility at present. As part of the integrated Governance, Risk & Compliance organization, you will work across Risk Governance, Ethics & Compliance, ESG and Group Assurance to help establish effective and scalable governance.

You will independently develop, implement and manage the assigned programmes, frameworks and processes, translating the Group Integrity Framework into practical standards, controls and guidance. Working closely with relevant corporate functions, you will help prevent misconduct, respond credibly to potential violations and build a risk-based, scalable Compliance Management System for our growing international defense-technology business.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own and continuously enhance the Group Business Ethics & Integrity Program, covering the Code of Conduct, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Conflicts of Interest, Gifts & Hospitality, Donations and Sponsorships, ethical decision-making and non-retaliation.

  • Establish and implement policies, standards, guidance and processes, supported by risk-based training, communications and advice that enable practical application across the Group.

  • Manage the Group Speak-up & Whistleblowing Framework, including reporting channels, intake, triage, confidentiality, non-retaliation safeguards, case routing and effectiveness monitoring.

  • Lead sensitive and complex internal investigations and maintain the related case management framework, ensuring fair, objective, timely and confidential processes, robust investigation mandates, planning, interviews, evidence handling, documentation, escalation, reporting, data protection and retention.

  • Translate findings into sustainable improvement by identifying root causes and control weaknesses, agreeing corrective and preventive actions with accountable owners, and monitoring implementation and effectiveness.

  • Advise management and coordinate with relevant functions, providing concise reporting on material cases, trends, risks and remediation.



What you bring to the team:

  • Relevant experience in Business Ethics, Compliance, Corporate Investigations, white-collar crime or criminal law, with demonstrated experience leading complex international investigations.

  • A relevant degree or professional qualification and experience building effective ethics, anti-bribery, speak-up or investigations programmes.

  • Strong investigation skills, from interviews and evidence assessment to root-cause analysis, remediation and prevention.

  • Sound knowledge of business ethics, anti-bribery, whistleblower protection, data protection and employment law; defense, aerospace or government-contracting experience is a strong advantage.

title: Senior Manager Compliance Governance & Regulatory Affairs (m/f/d)
text:
At Quantum Systems, we develop advanced autonomous systems for defense and security across multiple domains, combining unmanned platforms with integrated software and AI.  

As Senior Manager Compliance Governance & Regulatory Affairs, you will play a key role in building and strengthening Quantum Systems’ Group Ethics & Compliance program. You will take end-to-end functional ownership for the Group Compliance Management System, with a focus on policy governance, compliance risk assessment, regulatory change management and implementation, compliance monitoring and reporting, data protection coordination, and governance oversight of selected regulatory compliance areas such as trade compliance.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with clear functional ownership and no direct people-management responsibility at present. You will independently develop, implement and continuously improve the compliance programs, frameworks and processes within your area of responsibility, translating regulatory requirements into practical, risk-based and scalable compliance structures. Working closely with relevant corporate functions and subject-matter owners, you will help embed effective compliance into how our fast-growing international business operates and scales.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own and continuously enhance the Group Compliance Management System, including compliance governance, policy governance, standards, responsibilities and supporting processes.

  • Lead compliance risk assessments and regulatory change management and implementation, assessing regulatory developments and translating relevant requirements into clear responsibilities, implementation plans and controls.

  • Own compliance monitoring and reporting, establishing risk-based monitoring activities, compliance KPIs and management reporting, and tracking identified issues and remediation.

  • Coordinate data protection across the Group, working with relevant stakeholders and the data protection Officer to support effective governance and implementation of privacy requirements.

  • Provide governance oversight of selected regulatory compliance areas, including trade compliance, establishing appropriate responsibilities, oversight, escalation and management transparency.

  • Advise management and support regulatory and assurance readiness, providing guidance on compliance risks and priorities and coordinating regulatory assessments, audits and related remediation.



What you bring to the team:

  • Relevant experience in compliance governance, regulatory compliance or compliance program management, ideally in an international and highly regulated environment.

  • A relevant degree or professional qualification, with proven ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into pragmatic governance, processes and controls.

  • Solid experience in compliance management systems, including risk assessments, policy governance, monitoring, controls, regulatory change and management reporting.

  • A digital mindset and affinity for technology, with the ability to effectively use AI, data and modern compliance tools to improve processes, monitoring and reporting.

  • Strong analytical, project management and stakeholder skills, with the ability to independently drive complex cross-functional initiatives and advise senior management.

  • A pragmatic, hands-on and ownership-driven mindset; experience in defence, aerospace, government contracting

Accountant

Our Mission For You

Help us build an in-house accounting function from the ground up. trawa is bringing its bookkeeping in-house, and you'll be one of the people who makes that work: clean books, on time, every month.

trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're a hyper-growth energy-tech company with strong team growth, backed by Balderton Capital, Speedinvest and Headline. Our business model sits at the intersection of energy, tech, and finance, which makes our accounting more complex and more interesting than a typical start-up ledger.

You'll start hands-on with day-to-day accounting and keep the books clean as volumes grow. At the same time, you'll spot the manual steps in your work and get room to automate them. You'll also be part of our ERP rollout. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own their area, not just process it.

What You'll Own

Accounts Payable

  • Handle expenses and credit card bookings

  • Maintain vendor master data and keep supplier accounts reconciled

  • Prepare payment runs

Month-End Support

  • Reconcile bank transactions

  • Prepare accruals and reconciliations for your areas

  • Support the monthly close and year-end, working with our auditors

  • Keep documentation GoBD-compliant and audit-ready

Build & Improve

  • Spot manual steps in your processes and automate them

Must-haves

  • Solid understanding of German GAAP (HGB) and VAT basics

  • Precise and fast. You care about getting it right and getting it done

  • Analytical and confident in Excel or Google Sheets for reconciliations

  • Fluent in English

Nice-to-haves

  • German is a strong plus (B1 or better): most of our vendor invoices and much of our supplier communication are in German

  • Experience in a fast-growing company (start-up or scale-up), or at a tax firm serving start-up clients

  • Hands-on with DATEV Rechnungswesen and DATEV Unternehmen online (DUO)

  • Training as Steuerfachangestellte/r or Kaufmann/-frau

  • Experience with Moss or similar spend management tools

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Agent team.

We are building a platform for creating, publishing, and executing AI-powered agents that help teams automate complex workflows in financial services. The Agents team owns the agent execution runtime, tool orchestration, and platform infrastructure that makes this possible, including the conversational copilot experiences built on top of it across the product.

title: iOS Engineer - Design System
text:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

 

What you'll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

 

You'll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
  • Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
  • Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
  • Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
  • Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
  • Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which you can be used to attend conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave d

The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces.

How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

  • Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany

  • Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start

  • Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do

  • Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs

What you'll bring:

  • Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

title: Staff Engineer
text:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.

title: Growth Consultant | Deutsch C2
text:
Growth Consultant (m/w/d), Account Management für 30 bis 40 B2B Tech Kunden in Berlin

Die meisten Account-Management-Jobs heißen Beratung und bestehen am Ende aus Reporting-Decks und Ticket-Pingpong. Hier ist es umgekehrt: Die Umsetzung macht das Team, du berätst.

Unser Kunde ist eine AI-first GTM Agentur aus Berlin Mitte. Seit 2024 auf über 5 Mio. EUR ARR und 30+ Leute gewachsen, mit 200+ B2B Tech Kunden, von der Mobility-App über einen Schweizer Telko-Konzern bis zum Bildungsverlag. Zuletzt kam in einem einzigen Monat über 1 Mio. EUR neuer ARR dazu.

Jeder dieser Kunden braucht jemanden, der ihn hält und ausbaut. Genau dafür ist dieser Seat da.

Das Paket: 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention, Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage Office und 2 Tage remote.

Tasks

  • Du führst dein eigenes Portfolio aus ca. 30 bis 40 Accounts und sitzt alle zwei Wochen mit Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern im Termin.

  • Deine Kunden sind B2B Software- und Tech-Firmen, die über Google, LinkedIn, Meta und signalbasiertes Outbound ihre Pipeline aufbauen. Insgesamt laufen jeden Monat sechsstellige Budgets in Paid Search und Paid Social über die Agentur.

  • Der typische Moment: Ein Geschäftsführer, der viel Geld in Ads und Outbound steckt, fragt dich, warum seine Leads teurer geworden sind und ob er das Budget kürzen soll. Du hast die Antwort und den nächsten Schritt.

  • Beratung statt Operatives: Kampagnen bauen die GTM- und Performance-Marketing-Teams. Du entscheidest mit dem Kunden, was als Nächstes gebaut wird.

  • Upsell und Retention sind dein Hebel: neuer Kanal, mehr Budget, Verlängerung. Dein Spielfeld ist das bestehende Portfolio.

  • Du liest die Zahlen deiner Accounts (Leads, Cost per Lead, Pipeline) und siehst ein Abwanderungsrisiko, bevor der Kunde es ausspricht.

Requirements

  • Ein paar Jahre B2B mit echter, eigener Kundenverantwortung. Ob als Account Manager, BDM, kommerzielles Customer Success, AE mit Bestandskunden oder Founder’s Associate, der Titel ist egal. Interne Koordination oder reines Projektmanagement zählt hier nicht.

  • Du erzählst deinen Track Record in Zahlen: wie viele Accounts, welche Retention, wie viel Upsell-Volumen.

  • Wenn dir ein Geschäftsführer im Call sagt, die Leads taugen nichts und er überlegt zu kündigen, gehst du in die Daten statt in die Defensive und kommst mit einem Plan raus.

  • Du hältst 30+ Kunden parallel auf dem Schirm, ohne dass einer durchrutscht, und baust dir dafür dein eigenes System.

  • Du brauchst niemanden, der dir den Tag plant. Du siehst die Lücke und schließt sie.

  • Idealerweise hast du Outbound, Lead Gen oder B2B-Akquise schon selbst gemacht. Pluspunkte: Google oder LinkedIn Ads, CRM, Agentur-, Consulting- oder Startup-Background.

  • Fix: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, gutes Englisch, Festanstellung in Vollzeit, 3 Tage pro Woche im Berliner Office (der erste Monat komplett vor Ort).

  • Early Career bis Mid. Gesucht ist Hunger, nicht Seniorität: Wer seit Jahren Senior Advisory macht, wird hier nicht glücklich. Ein Abschluss oder ein großes Logo im Lebenslauf sind nicht das Tor, deine Zahlen schon.

Benefits

  • 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention. Du verdienst also auch daran, dass Kunden bleiben, nicht nur an neuen Deals.

  • Perspektive: Die Agentur sucht explizit Leute, die Experten- oder Führungsverantwortung übernehmen wollen.

  • Lernkurve: Alle zwei Wochen sitzt du mit Geschäftsführern aus 30 bis 40 verschiedenen B2B Tech Firmen am Tisch. Nach 12 Monaten kannst du einem GF sagen, welcher Kanal sich für sein Geschäftsmodell rechnet und welcher nicht.

  • 1:1 Coaching mit erfahrenen Leuten ab Tag 1.

  • Office in Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage vor Ort und 2 remote,

Die Mandate reichen vom Weltkonzern bis zum Stealth-Startup, dazu US-Firmen beim Markteintritt in Deutschland. Die Teamlead-Rolle hat gerade höchste Priorität.

Das Paket: 60k EUR Fix, OTE bis 100k, Bonus ungedeckelt, Berlin hybrid ohne starre Office-Policy.

Tasks

  • Du führst ein Team von 5 bis 8 SDRs, das für Kunden Termine bucht. Rund 70% Führung: Coaching, Call-Reviews, Kampagnensteuerung, Reporting.

  • Rund 30% operativ: Du bleibst selbst am Telefon und springst rein, wo es brennt.

  • Die Mandate: Smart Building und Gebäudetechnik, KI-Softwareentwicklung, Fördermittel, Deep Tech, Sondermaschinenbau, Stadtwerke, internationale Sales-Tech-Plattformen.

  • Du hast täglich Kundenkontakt, auch mit CEOs und Head ofs. Der typische Moment: Ein CEO, der für Outbound bezahlt, will wissen, warum diese Woche weniger Termine kamen als geplant. Du erklärst es mit Zahlen und verkaufst den nächsten Schritt.

  • Eigene Kundenprojekte: Du setzt neue Mandate auf (ICP, Liste, Messaging, Kadenz) und richtest das Team darauf aus. Internationale Projekte wie US-Markteintritte landen oft genau bei den Teamleads.

  • Du steuerst über Calls, Connect Rate, Meetings und Show Rate pro SDR und weißt, an welchem Hebel du drehst.

  • Stack: Clay, Lemlist, n8n, Attio, Placetel, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, plus eine eigene KI-Unit mit automatisierter Recherche und KI-Call-Coaching.

Requirements

  • Du warst selbst SDR und hast kalt telefoniert. Du weißt, wie sich der 60. Call am Tag anfühlt, und genau daher kommt deine Glaubwürdigkeit als Coach.

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr echte Führungserfahrung als Teamlead im B2B. Reines B2C reicht hier nicht.

  • Wenn ein SDR seit Wochen unter Ziel liegt, hast du einen Plan: Call-Review, Roleplay, 1:1, und wenn nötig auch die Konsequenz.

  • Vor einem CEO bleibst du ruhig, klar und hast die Zahlen parat, gerade in einer schlechten Woche.

  • Nicht für alles gibt es einen Prozess. Du baust mit, statt dich an Zuständigkeiten festzuhalten.

  • Fix: fließend Deutsch, Wohnort Berlin.

  • Ehrlich gesagt: Wenn du heute Head of bist und dieses Level halten willst, ist das eine Ebene zu tief. Und wer nur noch steuern und nicht mehr telefonieren will, ist hier falsch. Ein Abschluss oder ein großes Logo im Lebenslauf sind nicht das Tor, deine Team-Zahlen schon.

Benefits

  • 60k EUR Fix, OTE bis 100k, Bonus ungedeckelt. Das Fixum ist bewusst moderat, der Bonus ist der Hebel für alle, die mit ihrem Team Leistung bringen wollen.

  • Perspektive: mehr Verantwortung über eigene Kundenprojekte und größere Teams, Richtung Project Lead mit Verantwortung für Kundenaccounts und SDR-Teams.

  • Lernkurve: Mandate quer durch Branchen, vom Konzern bis zum Stealth-Startup, plus internationale Markteintritte. Nach 12 Monaten setzt du ein Outbound-Projekt in jeder Branche von null auf und bringst ein Team darauf.

  • Coaching mit Daten statt Bauchgefühl: KI-Recherche und KI-Call-Coaching aus der hauseigenen KI-Unit machen deine SDRs schneller besser.

  • Hybrid ohne starre Policy: Office am Moritzplatz, viel Präsenz ist erwünscht, ein Monat von woanders ist in der Regel drin.

  • Junges Team

title: Operations & Automation Associate
text:
About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".

title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
text:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Fractile is building the next generation of AI computing technology, developing innovative hardware and software solutions designed to transform the performance and efficiency of AI workloads.

We're bringing together exceptional talent across semiconductor engineering, software, and AI to solve some of the most ambitious challenges in computing.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and highly technical Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead Fractile's information security, corporate IT, and IT infrastructure functions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive technology and security strategy, ensuring Fractile's systems, infrastructure, intellectual property, and business operations are secure, reliable, and scalable.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role, combining cybersecurity expertise with ownership of IT operations, infrastructure, and service delivery. You will build and lead high-performing teams, establish robust processes and governance, and ensure our technology environment supports Fractile's rapid growth and engineering ambitions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Fractile's information security, IT, and infrastructure strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, and global growth.

  • Own and oversee corporate IT operations, infrastructure, networks, cloud environments, endpoints, and enterprise systems, ensuring high availability, performance, security, and scalability.

  • Lead IT service delivery, including employee technology, hardware and software provisioning, IT support, onboarding and offboarding, asset management, and enterprise applications.

  • Protect Fractile's proprietary semiconductor designs, intellectual property, source code, research, and confidential business information against internal and external threats.

  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure supporting semiconductor development, software engineering, and research environments.

  • Establish and maintain cybersecurity governance, risk management frameworks, policies, and controls aligned with recognised industry standards and regulatory requirements.

title: Analytics Engineer
text:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have

  • 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

  • A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

  • Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. The team you'll be joining and impact you'll have

  • You'll own how V7 looks and feels to the world, across both the marketing site and the product itself. This is a product and brand design role first: you'll be setting the visual direction, designing the product experience and making sure the two hang together.

  • Our design team is small and sits close to engineering. Designers here work directly with the people building the product, and the loop between a design decision and it appearing in the codebase is short.

  • Define motion and interaction: animation, empty and loading states, transitions, and the detail that makes a product feel finished. Where it's quicker to tweak it yourself in the codebase, you can.

  • Take on genuinely new surfaces that don't have a pattern yet, like visualising the Context Graph: nodes, edges, and how a knowledge graph should actually read on screen.

title: Software Engineer, Web (Full stack)
text:
We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts with a high sense of ownership. This commitment to expertise is an expectation for every team member.

As a Web Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

Platform Engineering

Designing and building robust, scalable web platforms end-to-end in TypeScript: APIs, services, data access layers and the UI on top of them. You’ll make the architectural decisions and set the patterns that others build on.

Workflows & Data Pipelines

Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

Data Modeling & Visualization

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. You’ll handle data with privacy in mind from the very first design decision.

Maps & Geospatial Data

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

Roadmap Creation and Ideation

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

Owning your scope

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.


Your Skills & Experience:

Please indicate your years of experience on the application form.

  • 7+ years of professional experience building SaaS products or data-heavy platforms.

  • High proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in modern web frameworks (React, Next.js…).

  • Strong experience with Postgres and data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).

  • Solid understanding of data modeling for analytics and for visualizing large volumes of data.

  • A privacy-aware approach to handling sensitive data, such as aggregation and anonymization.

  • Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running processes (Restate, Temporal, or similar) is a big plus.

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.

  • Strong understanding of web performance: rendering strategies (SSR, edge, static), caching, CDNs, Core Web Vitals, and how mobile and in-app browsers behave.

  • Hands-on experience with deep linking, Universal Links / App Links and attribution. Experience with App Clips is a big plus.

title: Communications, Brand & Events Lead
text:
About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials, and every failure costs patients precious time.

Orakl exists to change those odds.

We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients, combining real patients' tumors with their medical histories and deep biological data. By integrating patient-derived tumor models, experimental biology and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in drug development.

Founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD, and Gustave Ronteix, PhD, Orakl is a spin-out of Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centres, building on a decade of research. Backed by international investors, we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide.

Discover more at orakl-oncology.com

The role

We are looking for our first Communications, Brand & Events Lead to build Orakl's external presence from the ground up and establish the company as a leading voice in AI-driven cancer drug development. Your job is to make the world understand what we are building, why it matters and why Orakl is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation.

You will shape how Orakl is perceived by the pharmaceutical companies we partner with, the scientists we want to attract, the investors backing us and the broader industry. From defining our corporate narrative and building our reputation to securing media coverage and putting Orakl in the right rooms, you will turn our scientific and commercial progress into visibility, credibility and meaningful relationships.

You will own our communications, brand and events strategy, working directly with the founders and closely with our scientific, BD and Product Marketing teams. While Product Marketing focuses on our offerings and their commercial value, you will own Orakl's corporate voice, reputation and external presence. You will also lead internal events and support on internal brand alignment.

This is a strategic but highly hands-on role. You will set the direction, build the function and execute much of it yourself, with the autonomy to experiment, make decisions and shape how Orakl grows.

You will need to combine the speed and creativity of a startup with the standards of the pharmaceutical industry. Our communications must be distinctive and ambitious, but always grounded in scientific rigour, evidence and credibility.

What you'll do

Communications and brand: building Orakl's voice

  • Communications strategy. Define and execute Orakl's communications strategy across audiences, channels and markets, setting clear priorities that support the company's commercial, scientific, talent and fundraising ambitions.

  • Corporate positioning and narrative. Own Orakl's corporate story, key messages and tone of voice. Build a distinctive narrative around virtual patients and Orakl's role in advancing cancer drug development, ensuring consistency across the company.

  • Brand identity and presence.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - Draft Showdown
text:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game.
You will be central to that transition.

Role

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

  • Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

  • Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

  • Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture

  • Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.

Profile

  • 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong knowledge of computer science fundamental

title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
text:
Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes.

Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations.

Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. 

Vos missions

  • Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules.
  • Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer.
  • Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais.
  • Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle.

Requirements

Indispensable

  • Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé).
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer.
  • Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements.

Important

  • Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs.
  • Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés.

Un plus

  • Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers).
  • Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique.
  • Expérience en pression ou température.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d’ingénieur (bac +5) en mécanique, génie physique, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Un parcours associant mécanique et mesures physiques (BUT Mesures physiques puis école d’ingénieurs en mécanique) est particulièrement apprécié.
  • Environ 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’équipements, bureau d’études ou R&D ; profils plus juniors étudiés.
  • Poste orienté conception et terrain : une thèse n’est pas requise.

Conditions

Sur site. Manutention occasionnelle de pièces métalliques lourdes avec moyens de levage. Intéressement
Rémunération : 36 – 48 k€ brut annuel selon expérience

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&a

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

text:
EggAI · Banking transformation programme (UK) · Remote, UK-facing — London for gate weeks

About the Programme

EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production.

EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers.

The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems.

The Role

Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what "ready to run in production" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold.

The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. Agentic AI workloads need a different operating model, and you will shape it: redraw responsibilities between the client's teams and its managed service providers, set the standards each party works to, and lead the people through the change — so that those who run the platform today are ready and willing to run what comes next.

This is a lead/principal position reporting to the Programme Plan and Execution Lead. It is remote, with regular London presence required for gate weeks and workshops.

Responsibilities

  • Reliability targets — set the SLO and error-budget framework alongside the client's existing structure, have the service owners adopt it, and commission the behavioural quality measures that do the same job for agentic workloads

  • Observability and detection — define what Tier-1 services and agentic workloads must emit, including trajectory logging; require an automated path from a firing alert to the affected services and their owners; and hold the operating teams to closing the logging gaps in what runs today

  • The incident and change path — set the runbook standard and its required coverage, extend incident classification and intervention mechanisms to agentic failure modes, and have rollback and change-failure rates measured and reported by those who own them

  • Capacity and performance — direct the headroom position through the parallel-run peak at cutover, sponsor the chaos and game-day programme for payment rails and the core ledger, and mandate that capacity modelling covers inference workloads

  • Gate evidence — own the technical content of the Operational Acceptance Report and Operational Readiness Certificate, the reliability section of each gate pack, and the reliability NFRs defended as ADRs through the client's Architecture Design Authority — written by the teams, reviewed and signed off by you

  • The operating organisation — decide how responsibilities sit between the client's teams and its managed service providers for the new platform, and lead the people concerned through that change

Expected experience

  • 10+ years in leading IT operations teams — You have operated L1, L2, and L3 support as SRE, platform reliability or infrastructure organisations, with the people and the providers reporting to you

text:

title: Managing Principal - Software Engineering & Architecture H/F
Senior Sales Engineer, France
text:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

Horizon3 is committed to defending businesses from the ever-growing threat landscape. Our advanced solutions and expert team provide unparalleled security for our clients. We are looking for a passionate Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect to join our team and help prospects and clients understand the true value and capabilities of our products and services.

  • Technical expertise - Demonstrate deep knowledge of our cybersecurity products and services, assisting the sales team in presenting and position them to prospects and clients

  • Customer engagement - Meet with potential customers to understand their cybersecurity needs, challenges, and infrastructure, ensuring that our solutions are the perfect fit for them

  • Product demonstrations - Provide live demos and proof of concepts for our cybersecurity solutions, tailoring each demo to the specific needs and concerns of the potential customer

  • Solution development - Will work closely with the sales and product teams to design and refine our solutions based on customer needs

  • Technical training - train the sales team on the technical aspects of our products to enhance their ability to sell more effectively

  • Feedback loop - relay feedback from the field to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the ongoing improvement of our product

  • RFP/RFI assistance - Assist in answering technical sections of RFPs and RFIs

  • Post-sales support - On rare occasions, assist in post-sales processes to ensure the smooth implementation and satisfaction of our customers

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Pre-Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect in the cybersecurity domain

  • Strong understanding of cyber threats, risk management, and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated ability to simplify complex technical topics for a non-technical audience

  • Highly collaborative with a strong sense of initiative

title: Product Owner (spéc. Tableau de bord)
text:
Contexte :

Nous recherchons, pour notre client, un grand groupe télécom, un Product Owner spécialisé en tableaux de bord pour piloter le run et les évolutions de notre patrimoine de dataviz, au service des équipes construction.

Ce Product Owner garantit que les utilisateurs disposent de tableaux de bord fiables, disponibles et utiles sur l'ensemble de leurs activités : construction, MCO (maintien en conditions opérationnelles) et SAV.

Vous serez le point de contact privilégié des utilisateurs pour leurs besoins de data visualisation. Vous travaillerez à partir des données déjà présentes dans GCP ou HDF, et produirez les tableaux de bord dans Power BI On Cloud, dans le respect de la charte graphique.

Vous représenterez également notre collectif et nos façons de travailler auprès de l'équipe DATA IA, et relaierez ses préconisations sur Power BI et Looker Studio.

Responsabilités clés

Votre mission centrale : assurer le run du patrimoine de tableaux de bord (Power BI On Cloud ou Google Looker Studio) et accompagner les salariés sur leurs besoins de data visualisation.

  1. Piloter le développement des tableaux de bord

o Cadrer et spécifier les besoins avec les utilisateurs.

o Découper les besoins en user stories et rédiger leurs critères d'acceptation.

o Suivre la réalisation avec l'équipe de développement nearshore, du backlog jusqu'à la mise en production.

  1. Maintenir le patrimoine existant

o Garantir la disponibilité et le bon fonctionnement des tableaux de bord de notre espace de travail Power BI.

o Optimiser leur coût de fonctionnement.

o Veiller au respect de la charte graphique.

  1. Accompagner les utilisateurs

o Traiter les demandes d'ajout, de correction ou de suppression de fonctionnalités des salariés.

o Appuyer l'équipe PDATA sur ses sujets dataviz en cours, notamment le tableau de bord performance.

  1. Animer le cadre agile

o Gérer et prioriser le backlog JIRA Dataviz (WSJF ou équivalent).

o Faciliter les cérémonies : lancement de sprint, points d'équipe, revues et rétrospectives.

  1. Être force de proposition auprès de DATA IA

o Représenter notre collectif et nos façons de travailler.

o Relayer les préconisations sur les outils Power BI et Looker Studio.

Résultats attendus :

Les livrables sont remis en français, après chaque bilan de sprint.

· Formulaire JIRA Dataviz mis en œuvre.

· Backlog JIRA Dataviz rédigé et ordonnancé.

· Comptes rendus des cérémonies agiles (lancement de sprint, réunions, rétrospectives).

· Tableaux de bord dans Power BI On Cloud ou Looker Studio livrés sans anomalie.

· Indicateurs de pilotage de l'activité Dataviz, mesurant le type de demande, l'entité du demandeur, la durée de traitement de chaque carte JIRA, du backlog jusqu'à l'implémentation et la satisfaction des utilisateurs, via un bilan systématique.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes un profil hybride, à l'aise aussi bien avec la donnée qu'avec l'animation d'équipe et la relation utilisateur.

· Background technique Data : vous comprenez les modèles de données, les requêtes et le fonctionnement d'un tableau de bord de bout en bout.

· Au moins 3 ans d'expérience comme Product Owner ou chef de projet, très à l'aise avec l'agilité (Scrum, SAFe).

· Expérience du pilotage d'un delivery nearshore : priorisation, suivi des engagements, recette.

· Sens du service et disponibilité auprès des utilisateurs métier.

· Capacité à formaliser : spécifications, user stories, comptes rendus et indicateurs de suivi.

· Force de proposition, capable de porter la voix de l'équipe auprès d'i

Une expertise technique est un vrai atout pour dialoguer d'égal à égal avec l'équipe, mais l'enjeu n'est pas de coder ni d'être le meilleur expert technique de la pièce.

Gestion de projets techniques

title: Lead Software Engineer
text:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team.

Lead what comes next: With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products.

Our stack:

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

  • Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

  • DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

title: Projectontwikkelaar
text:
Ben jij een projectontwikkelaar met een passie voor vastgoed en gebiedsontwikkeling? Heb je al de nodige vlieguren gemaakt met complexe projecten en voel je je thuis in samenwerkingen met diverse partijen? Wil je zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken aan uitdagende projecten, van haalbaarheid tot realisatie? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Dit wordt jouw baan

Als projectontwikkelaar leid je vastgoedprojecten van concept tot realisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, verkoop en het volledige procesmanagement. Van haalbaarheidsstudies tot de start van de bouw: jij houdt het overzicht. Je onderhoudt relaties met partners, beleggers, woningcorporaties en overheden en zorgt voor een vlotte samenwerking tussen alle betrokkenen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die bij gebiedsontwikkelingen bijdraagt aan het realiseren van impact op jouw (deel)project.

Dankzij je ervaring met complexe projecten (appartementen en binnenstedelijke ontwikkelingen) weet je snel te schakelen tussen belanghebbenden en bewaak je het totaalplaatje, inclusief conceptontwikkeling, duurzaamheid, budget en planning.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Markt & Klant: Analyseren van de marktvraag en het ontwikkelen van passende product-marktcombinaties. Opstellen van grond- en vastgoedexploitaties en coördineren van verkooptrajecten. Onderhouden en uitbouwen van relaties met beleggers en woningcorporaties.

  • Locatie & RO: Begeleiden van RO-procedures en vergunningstrajecten.

  • Organisatie: Coördineren van het ontwikkelings- en ontwerpproces, inclusief de financiële en commerciële aspecten.

  • Tijd & Geld: Opstellen en bewaken van exploitaties en planningen, uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en voeren van onderhandelingen om de beste resultaten te behalen. Jij hebt als geen ander gevoel voor het sluiten van goede deals.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

title: Senior Projectmanager
text:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewa

title: Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician
text:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards.

This is a hands-on execution role. You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager, who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). You take your daily and weekly priorities from the Assembly Tech Lead, who sets the assembly schedule and is the technical authority on the floor; fridge loading is planned in close coordination with the measurement team.

What you'll be doing

Core Responsibilities

  • Assemble quantum chips into their packaging, working from technical drawings and work instructions to place and mount the chip in its housing and mount the chip in its housing with the PCB.

  • Make the electrical connections, wirebonding (manual and automatic) will be a significant part of the daily activities, as well as manual soldering.

  • Measure and test your work, performing the defined electrical and mechanical checks and recording the results, so issues are caught before a device moves on.

  • Finish and close the package, including sealing, inspection, laser engraving and preparing for transportation to the measurement location.

  • Load our cryogenic fridges with new chips to be measured, mounting packaged samples and QPUs, making the wiring, thermal and mechanical connections, and closing up the system with magnetic shields.

  • Safeguard quality, handling fragile, high-value parts with care and following handling and ESD procedures, because a single scratch, particle or ESD event can ruin a chip.

Supporting Responsibilities

  • Flag deviations early, stopping and raising it with the Assembly Tech Lead when something does not match the instruction or does not look right, rather than improvising a fix.

  • Help improve how we work, giving practical feedback on work instructions, fixtures and tools while our processes are still maturing.

text:

Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen.

Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken.

Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren?

Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams.

  • Je deelt inzichten uit de praktijk met onze product- en engineeringteams, zodat we onze warmtepompen verder kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je denkt mee over hoe we onze processen en systemen kunnen verbeteren en automatiseren.

Je komt terecht in een groeiend team waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Dat betekent dat je veel kunt leren, verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en zelf invloed hebt op hoe we werken.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken.

title: Meewerkstage: Communicatie
text:
Wat ga je doen?

Hoe zorg je ervoor dat 800+ collega’s wereldwijd weten wat er binnen Voortman speelt én zich betrokken voelen bij de organisatie? Met verschillende vestigingen, landen, afdelingen en groepen collega’s is dat een mooie communicatie-uitdaging. Want niet iedere doelgroep bereik je op dezelfde manier en niet ieder verhaal vertel je via hetzelfde kanaal.

Als stagiair Communicatie draai je volop mee binnen ons communicatieteam. Je staat midden in de organisatie en spreekt collega’s van allerlei afdelingen: van productie en engineering tot service en sales. Je ontdekt wat er speelt, haalt verhalen en ontwikkelingen op en denkt mee over hoe we die op een interessante en relevante manier onder de aandacht brengen bij onze verschillende doelgroepen. Daarbij werk je met allerlei vormen van communicatie en content. De ene keer schrijf je een artikel of werk je mee aan een magazine, de andere keer denk je mee over een video of ondersteun je bij de communicatie rondom een grote interne bijeenkomst voor honderden collega’s. Je kijkt steeds naar wat je wilt vertellen, wie je wilt bereiken en welke vorm daar het beste bij past.

Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelf ideeën aan te dragen, initiatief te nemen en dingen uit te proberen. title: Robotics Engineer - Integration & Control (m/f/d)
text:
About Prefiro

Asparagus cost up to 25 euros per kilo this season! That’s because, like most of the produce on the shelf, it’s harvested exclusively by hand. Here at Prefiro, we’re the first to automate these processes! We use artificial intelligence, and robotics to bring next-generation agricultural equipment to the field.

Are you excited about applying new technologies in real-world conditions, solving interesting and varied problems, and seeing firsthand the impact your ideas have?

Then join our growing team and help us deliver the first autonomous asparagus harvester to farms.

Your responsibilities

  • Integrate robots and IO into the robotics stack – from startup and service to error handling and recovery.

  • Work on MPC-based trajectory planning and optimal control: from approach to implementation on the robot in real time.

  • Help optimize cycle times in real-world applications

  • Scale the stack from one robot module to several per machine: networking, robot setup and calibration.

  • Tune the robot computers for real-time control: Docker, CPU pinning, ROS 2 scheduling and multithreading.

  • Build remote access, data collection and robotics CI/CD (e.g. rosbag-playback tests) to improve the robots with real field data.

  • Review code, contribute to architecture decisions and debug the stack as a team.

  • Run the robots during pre-season field tests and the harvest season.

What you bring

  • Master's Degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in robotics, including hands-on work with real robots (not only simulation).

  • Strong modern C++ (C++17) and Python 3.

  • Hands-on experience with ROS 2 (ideally Jazzy): nodes, lifecycle nodes, executors, QoS, launch files.

  • Experience with trajectory controllers and trajectory planning.

  • Solid grounding in robot kinematics and dynamics (URDF, Pinocchio or similar).

  • Proven experience with optimal control and model predictive control for trajectory planning; reinforcement learning is a plus.

  • Comfortable with CMake/colcon builds and Git on Linux.

  • Experience with real-time robot control and an understanding of soft real-time constraints on Linux (scheduling, latency, threading).

  • Fluent English, our working language.

Nice to have

  • Industrial arms, especially Denso SCARA (b-CAP, RC8) or Universal Robots.

  • Optimal-control frameworks such as acados or CasADi; control barrier functions.

  • MoveIt 2 or Ruckig for motion planning.

  • Docker, GitLab CI and automated testing (GoogleTest, launch_testing).

  • DDS or Zenoh tuning and multi-robot setups.

  • Debugging tools such as RViz, Foxglove, PlotJuggler or Nsight Systems.

  • Field deployment with systemd, tmux and shell scripting.

  • Basic German.

What we offer

  • Real fields from your first season. Your code runs on our machines on farms in Germany.
