text:
Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Principal Engineer, Data Quality Platform

You'll own data correctness across Talos. You'll lead the data quality engineering team, run BAU data operations, and own reference and security master data, along with the pipelines and platform that deliver it.

Our goal: the data we return to clients is always correct, and we find defects before a client does.

You'll join a small team with the mandate to work independently from product engineering and challenge it. Engineering teams make assumptions about how their systems behave. Your job is to test those assumptions and prove or disprove them with evidence.

 

Responsibilities

  • Lead AI-first data quality engineering

  • Validate every client-facing endpoint continuously. The focus is our REST and WebSocket APIs. Cloud delivery (S3, Snowflake, Databricks) is also in scope. Assert correctness against independent sources of truth, across every environment and client entitlement.

  • Cover streaming as well as request/response. For WebSocket, that means:

  • sequencing and gap detection

  • snapshot-to-increment consistency

  • reconnect and replay correctness

  • staleness of live subscriptions

  • agreement between the streamed view and the REST view of the same state

  • Use adaptive detection, not static thresholds. Learn baselines per endpoint and per market, and let them adjust as "normal" changes. Hand-set limits get noisy, go stale, and teach people to ignore alerts.

  • Apply LLM and agentic tooling to generate checks from API specs and schemas, keep them current as the product changes, and triage alerts before a human sees them. Know when a deterministic rule, invariant or cross-source reconciliation is the better tool.

  • Test resilience and load. Design load, performance and failure-mode tests.

  • When you find a fault, raise it with the owning team with enough evidence for them to act. Drive it to resolution, then add a check that would have caught it earlier.

  • Measure and publish endpoint and field coverage, time to detect, detected-before-client

Must-have

title: Founding Deployment Strategist [ERP + AI]
text:
TL;DR

  • We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce)

  • Founding deployment strategist: you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work

  • A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners

  • €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs)

  • €45–60k + equity

What this role is (and isn't)

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters.

This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Why now

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients.

What you'll do

  • Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment.

  • Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later.

  • Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow.

  • Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents.

  • Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it.

  • Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget.

  • Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear.

  • Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment.

What you bring

You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floo

In your capacity as a Propulsion AIT Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

Qualifications:

  • Young graduate in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or another related field (master's and above preferred), preferably with rocketry experience or individual projects

What we would love to see from you:

  • Experience assembling or integrating mechanical systems in a laboratory, workshop, production, or test environment, ideally related to propulsion, pressure systems, fluidic assemblies, or complex hardware

  • Familiarity with CAD, PLM, ERP, manufacturing execution, or technical documentation systems

  • Understanding with torque-controlled assembly, cleanliness practices, FOD prevention, leak testing, pressure testing, or dimensional inspection

About Mistral

The Role

As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack.

This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production.

What You Will Do

  • Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses.

  • Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss.

  • Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack.

  • Partner with pretraining and RL teams when techniques require co-training, retraining, or training auxiliary models to improve inference.

Build the right tooling and validation platforms to facilitate AI-driven inference research.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong ML background with solid knowledge of LLM training techniques — architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

  • Hands-on experience with Python and PyTorch; you write clean, experimental code and iterate fast. JAX is acceptable with strong Python proficiency. C++ and Rust are not required, CUDA and GPU knowledge is expected but hands-on experience is not required.

title: Senior Documentation Specialist
text:
About this position

As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.

Your tasks:

  • Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system.

  • Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements.

  • Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks.

  • Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure.

  • Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions.

  • Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working.

  • Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance.

  • Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks.

  • Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices.

Role requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline.

  • Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment.

  • Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model.

  • Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight.

  • Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions.

  • Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment.

text:

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles.

Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés, vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie.

Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site.

📌 Votre rôle

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés, vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés.

Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance, ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire.

• Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA.
• Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées.
• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.

🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique
• Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1.
• Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels.
• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.

• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.

• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.

🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité
• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC).
• Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise.

🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance
• Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés.
• Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques.
• Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité
• Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire.
• Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA), aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité.
• Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés.

title: Senior SAP Analytics Architekt BDC – Aufbau Business Data Cloud, mit Potential

We're a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions and the momentum to back them up. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds like something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

Right now, our founders run our accounts themselves, in between everything else they do. Even witht his set-up, our net revenue retention sits at 155%. Our customers expand because the product delivers, not because anyone is managing them very actively yet.

title: Studentstage
text:
Kom stage lopen bij een van Nederlands toonaangevende kantoren in advocatuur en notariaat

Ben jij een rechtenstudent in de laatste fase van je studie en wil je ervaren hoe het eraan toegaat bij een groeiend, ambitieus en vernieuwend fullservice kantoor? Maak kennis met ons en ontdek zelf wat het betekent om in een gedreven en hecht team te werken!

Advocatuur

Wil jij ontdekken wat de advocatuur jou te bieden heeft? Bij VBK kun je kiezen uit twee uitdagende stages van twee maanden: een brede stage of een focusstage. 

  • Brede stage: je werkt mee binnen twee verschillende praktijkgroepen, waarbij je de eerste maand bij de ene praktijkgroep meedraait en de tweede maand bij de andere. Je kunt daarnaast worden ingezet voor opdrachten van andere praktijkgroepen en je kunt ook aansluiten bij inhoudelijke overleggen, besprekingen en zittingen van andere praktijkgroepen. Zo ervaar je in korte tijd de veelzijdigheid van de advocatuur én ons kantoor. Op deze manier ontdek je welke rechtsgebieden jou het meest aanspreken, waar jouw passie ligt en hoe het is om multidisciplinair te werken.

  • Focusstage: weet je al welke richting je op wilt? Kies dan voor een focusstage en beleef de dagelijkse praktijk van een specifieke praktijkgroep. Een mooie kans om je te specialiseren en uit te vinden hoe jouw toekomst eruit kan zien in jouw favoriete rechtsgebied.

Let op: de stagemogelijkheden zijn afhankelijk van beschikbaarheid, dus geef je voorkeur aan bij je sollicitatie.


Notariaat

Kies je voor een stage binnen het notariaat? Dan ontdek je alles over de fascinerende wereld van corporate en commercial real estate. Je krijgt een goed beeld van de dagelijkse praktijk, werkt nauw samen met onze notarissen, kandidaat-notarissen en advocaten, en je ervaart de diversiteit van het notariële vakgebied.

Klaar om jouw talenten te ontdekken, jezelf uit te dagen en te ontwikkelen? Zet dan jouw eerste stap op weg naar een veelbelovende carrière bij VBK.


Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Meewerken in echte zaken. Vanaf dag één krijg je een vaste begeleider die je wegwijs maakt in de vele facetten van ons vak. Je draait mee in lopende zaken, gaat mee naar zittingen en neemt deel aan cliëntbesprekingen. Daarnaast werk je inhoudelijk mee door notities, adviezen en processtukken op te stellen en doe je diepgaand jurisprudentie- en literatuuronderzoek. Jouw input telt! 

  • Vakkennis. Schuif aan bij de wekelijkse praktijkgroep-lunches, waar nieuwe zaken, jurisprudentie en literatuur worden besproken. Verder kun je deelnemen aan inhouse-cursussen, lezingen en pleitoefeningen van de Jonge Balie Midden-Nederland. Een unieke kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen en je kennis naar een hoger niveau te tillen.

  • Plezier en netwerken. Naast hard werken is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. title: Data Scientist
text:
Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow.

In a nutshell

  • Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed).

  • Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale.

  • Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics.

  • Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression.

  • Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events.

About Kaizo

At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing.

The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in.

What you'll focus on

  • Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably.

  • Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics.

  • Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume.

  • Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable.

  • Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions.

  • Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality).

  • Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product.

What you'll grow into

  • Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time.

  • Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation.

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
text:
Senior Marketing Manager

Location: Europe, Amsterdam preferred (hybrid or remote possible)
Competitive salary
Start date: as soon as possible

Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet.

We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework.

The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret.

  • The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story.

  • We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up.

  • Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation.

  • We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events.

  • Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs.

  • Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it.


That’s where you come in.

What this role really is

We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who:

  • Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search.

  • Turns our enterprise wins into case studies and references that open new doors.

  • Owns our review and analyst presence: a proper G2 strategy, competitor and comparison pages that convert, and support for analyst relations.

  • Gives Sales and CS the content, one-pagers, battlecards and decks that win deals and renewals.

  • Starts product marketing: positioning, launches, and clear messaging on AutoQA, Agentic QA, Insights and AI Coaching for customers and prospects.

  • Builds our brand through thought leadership, PR and executive content on the future of CX quality in an AI-agent world.

  • Owns our social channels and online reputation.

  • Defines and runs a field marketing plan, so Kaizo shows up at the international events that matter to our enterprise ICP.

  • Works with Sales on outbound and partner campaigns, including our helpdesk and Customer Service ecosystem partners.

You won’t inherit a polished machine. You’ll be the architect, the builder and the driver of Kaizo’s marketing.

The deal

  • Location: Amsterdam preferred, flexible across Europe, hybrid or remote possible.

  • Reporting: directly to Thibaud, Co-CEO, as part of the commercial leadership team.

  • Real ownership, a fast feedback loop with Sales and Product, and a seat at the table where positioning gets decided.

Why this matters

Marketing is the missing piece in Kaizo’s growth engine. The product is there, the enterprise customers are there and the deals are there. Now the market needs to know it, and we need demand that scales.

Over ons

Bij Care Expert werken we elke dag aan één praktisch doel: zorgen dat zorgorganisaties krijgen waar ze recht op hebben, zonder onnodig gedoe. Declareren in de zorg is ingewikkeld, foutgevoelig en tijdrovend – en dat zou eigenlijk niet zo moeten zijn.

Met ons platform helpen we zorgorganisaties om hun declaraties automatisch te laten kloppen. We vertalen complexe wet- en regelgeving naar software die controleert, voorkomt en verwerkt, zodat handmatig correctiewerk steeds minder nodig is.

Care Expert komt oorspronkelijk uit de praktijk. We leveren al jaren software én ondersteuning rondom zorgdeclaraties en weten daardoor precies waar het spaak loopt. Die kennis gebruiken we nu om verder te bouwen aan Care2Declare als volwaardig SaaS‑platform: schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en geïntegreerd met andere zorgsystemen zoals ECD’s en financiële software.

Bij Care Expert werk je aan een systeem dat een essentieel onderdeel vormt van hoe zorgorganisaties functioneren.

Over de functie

Binnen het team werk je aan software die zich richt op het facturatieproces van laboratoria. Via dit platform worden jaarlijks miljoenen declaraties verwerkt, een bedrijfskritische applicatie dus. Performance, stabiliteit en nauwkeurigheid zijn daarom belangrijk in alles wat we bouwen.

Als softwareontwikkelaar werk je aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbeter je bestaande onderdelen en los je bugs op die in de praktijk naar boven komen. title: Stagiair Finance
text:
Finance leer je pas echt als je ziet wat er achter de cijfers gebeurt.

Ben jij bezig met een opleiding richting Finance, Bedrijfsadministratie, Accountancy of Finance & Control en wil je tijdens je stage ervaren hoe een financiële administratie er in de praktijk uitziet? Dan hebben we binnen het Finance-team van Claus Group een mooie stageplek voor je.

Bij ons kijk je niet alleen mee. Je gaat vooral zelf aan de slag.

Je leert hoe facturen worden verwerkt, hoe betalingen en bankmutaties worden gecontroleerd, hoe we omgaan met debiteuren en crediteuren en hoe financiële gegevens uiteindelijk samenkomen in een betrouwbare administratie.

En die administratie is bij Claus behoorlijk veelzijdig. Binnen onze organisatie komen horeca, events en leisure samen. Een groot bedrijfsevent heeft financieel een heel andere dynamiek dan een avond BARRACA of een druk weekend bij Claus Bowling. Juist daardoor krijg je tijdens je stage te maken met verschillende soorten omzet, kosten, leveranciers en administratieve processen.

Je wordt begeleid door onze Finance-collega's en krijgt gedurende je stage steeds meer ruimte om werkzaamheden zelfstandig op te pakken. Natuurlijk houden we daarbij rekening met jouw opleiding, leerdoelen en wat je vanuit school moet aantonen.

Dit is Claus Group

Claus Group is een veelzijdige horecagroep waar gastvrijheid, kwaliteit en beleving centraal staan. Vanuit onze locaties in Hoofddorp en Amsterdam creëren wij elke dag opnieuw bijzondere ervaringen voor onze gasten.

Claus Group bestaat uit verschillende unieke hospitalitymerken. Bij Claus Events organiseren wij jaarlijks honderden congressen, vergaderingen, bedrijfsfeesten en andere zakelijke evenementen. Met 20 moderne bowlingbanen en het sfeervolle American 50’s Diner restaurant biedt Claus Bowling gasten een gezellige middag of avond uit. Bij Braziliaans restaurant BARRACA Rodizio Grill & Bar brengen we de warme Zuid-Amerikaanse gastvrijheid naar onze gasten met het unieke rodizio-concept.

Elk merk heeft zijn eigen karakter, maar samen vormen we met ruim 150 collega’s één familie. We staan voor elkaar klaar en doen er alles aan om de verwachtingen van onze gasten te overtreffen. Dat doen we met passie, vakmanschap en plezier. We geloven in korte lijnen, samenwerken, ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke aandacht. Of je nu werkt in de bediening, keuken, techniek, evenementen of op kantoor: iedere collega draagt bij aan de beleving van onze gasten. Jouw bijdrage maakt het verschil!

Bij Claus Group werk je niet zomaar in de horeca. Je werkt in een organisatie waar iedere dag iets anders gebeurt, waar collega's voor elkaar klaarstaan en waar je de ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Tijdens je stage draai je mee met de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van onze Finance-afdeling. We beginnen natuurlijk met een goede uitleg en begeleiding. Naarmate je meer leert, kun je steeds meer werkzaamheden zelfstandig uitvoeren.

Je gaat onder andere:

· Inkoopfacturen verwerken en controleren;

· Ondersteunen bij de debiteurenadminis

Je richt je voornamelijk op strategische IT-contracten. Omdat een groot deel van onze IT-dienstverlening is uitbesteed en de contracten inhoudelijk en qua aansturing complex zijn, zoeken we iemand met ervaring in IT-contractmanagement en het managen van IT-leveranciers.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Proactief managen van contracten om beoogde doelstellingen te realiseren, waaronder financiële inrichting en het oplossen van mogelijke onduidelijkheden (risicomanagement).

  • Actief bijdragen aan de implementatie van contracten binnen de organisatie.

  • Actief bijdragen aan het bepalen van de sourcingstrategie vooraf aan een aanbestedingstraject en aan de totstandkoming, verlenging en herziening van contracten.

  • Beheren van risico’s en oplossen van contractuele vraagstukken gedurende de looptijd van contracten.

  • Opstellen van heldere en tijdige contractrapportages voor management en stakeholders.

Team

Je komt terecht in het team Inkoop- en Contractmanagement, bestaande uit inkoopadviseurs, contractmanagers, een contractbeheerder en een manager. Samen zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van inkoop en contractmanagement, van initiatie tot uitvoering. Contractmanagement valt onder de afdeling Planning, Control en Financiën van Bedrijfsvoering en is binnen de AFM volop in ontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan het verder professionaliseren van beleid, processen, KPI’s, dashboards en rapportages. Daarbij werken we volgens de methodiek CATS CM en zetten we steeds meer in op data gedreven werken.

title: Toezichthouder cybersecurity Crypto
text:

Je beoordeelt de digitale weerbaarheid van organisaties en ziet toe op de naleving van de Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA). Daarbij combineer je kennis van wet- en regelgeving met inzicht in IT-risicobeheersing, cybersecurity en de technische werking van cryptodiensten. Je opereert in een dynamische en snel ontwikkelende markt waarin innovatie, toezicht en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

Afdeling en Team

Je maakt onderdeel uit van het team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het toezicht op operationele IT en werkt zeer nauw samen met team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het toezicht op cryptodienstverlening. Binnen deze snel ontwikkelende toezichtdomeinen werk je samen met specialisten op het gebied van toezicht, crypto , cybersecurity en wet- en regelgeving om bij te dragen aan een weerbare en integere financiële sector.


Dit vragen we:

⭐ Certificeringen zoals CISSP, CISM, CISA of vergelijkbaar zijn een pré;

⭐ Analytisch sterk: je doorgrondt complexe dossiers en onderscheidt hoofd- van bijzaken;

⭐ Eigenaarschap: je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en werkt proactief;

⭐ Samenwerken: je zoekt actief de samenwerking op, deelt kennis en draagt bij aan een positief teamresultaat;

title: Senior datamanagement specialist
text:
Als senior datamanagement specialist werk je aan een belangrijke ambitie: data binnen de AFM naar een niveau brengen waarop risico’s beheerst worden én data optimaal kan worden ingezet voor toezicht. Je helpt mee om data betrouwbaar, vindbaar en bruikbaar te maken en ondersteunt daarmee de ontwikkeling van de AFM als Smart Supervisor.

Samen met collega’s werk je aan het professionaliseren van datamanagement binnen de organisatie. Je ontwikkelt, implementeert en verbetert beleid, standaarden en werkwijzen. Daarnaast vervul je een voortrekkersrol bij organisatiebrede verbeterinitiatieven en coach je collega’s in het toepassen van datamanagementprincipes. Ook ondersteun je teams binnen de AFM met specialistische expertise en begeleid je collega’s bij veranderingen in de manier waarop met data wordt gewerkt.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Structureel verbeteren van masterdata, zoals vergunningen en ondernemingen.

  • Inrichten en verbeteren van metadata en datakwaliteit.

  • Initiëren en doorontwikkelen van datamanagementkaders: beleid, processen en standaarden die bijdragen aan datagedreven werken. Ontwikkelen en implementeren van Data Governance-structuur, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden, eigenaarschap en besluitvormingsprocessen rondom data.

  • Adviseren vanuit expertise aan ontwikkelteams bij complexe vraagstukken rondom bijvoorbeeld datamodellering, data-architectuur en autorisatiebeheer.

  • Leiden van organisatiebrede verbeterinitiatieven en creëren van draagvlak voor datagedreven werken binnen de AFM.

  • Coachen en begeleiden van (junior en medior) datamanagementspecialisten en fungeren als inhoudelijk expert binnen de organisatie.

Afdeling

Je werkt binnen de afdeling Data, Technologie en Innovatie in het team Datamanagement. Dit team ondersteunt toezichtsafdelingen en ondersteunende afdelingen met specialistische kennis op het gebied van onder andere data governance, datamodellering, masterdatamanagement, datakwaliteit en metadatamanagement.

Let op: Deze functie is aangemerkt als een kwetsbare functie. Voor interne medewerkers geldt dat bij een overstap naar deze functie een herscreening kan plaatsvinden.

Voorbeeld uit de praktijk

"Je werkt vanuit datamanagement aan de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe centrale capability: de Self Service Analyse Omgeving (SSA). Deze omgeving moet toezichthouders in staat stellen om zelfstandig analyses uit te voeren op beschikbare data. Hoe pak je dit aan?"

 

Je werkt samen met Data Analisten aan het opzetten van deze capability. Vanuit datamanagement ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het definiëren van de randvoorwaarden waarbinnen data veilig, verantwoord en effectief gebruikt kan worden. Daarbij richten jullie je op drie belangrijke onderdelen: Datatoegang: samen bepalen jullie welke datasets beschikbaar worden gesteld aan toezichtteams en hoe deze toegankelijk worden gemaakt. Governance en compliance: jij zorgt ervoor dat datagebruik voldoet aan wet- en regelgeving, waarbij herkomst, eigenaarschap, toegangsrechten en doelbinding van data duidelijk zijn vastgelegd. Standaardisatie: samen ontwikkelen jullie een centrale en uniforme werkwijze, zodat gebruikers data op een consistente manier kunnen raadplegen en analyseren. Uiteindelijk leveren jullie een veilige en gestandaardiseerde Self Service Analyse Omgeving op. Hierdoor kunnen toezichthouders zelfstandig inzichten verkrijgen uit data, terwijl de kwaliteit, veiligheid en governance van de data gewaarborgd blijven. Zo draagt de capability bij aan een meer datavaardige organisatie.

At Ockto, our mission is to set the benchmark for simple, secure, and ethical personal data sharing. Already a vital part of digital journeys like mortgage applications, rental agreements, and private lease processes, we enable people to control and share their sensitive data with confidence.

As our platform grows, reliability, scalability and security become increasingly important. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you help build and operate the platform that keeps Ockto available, secure and performant across millions of transactions — and you keep it that way as we scale into new markets.

We are a team of curious, highly skilled engineers who value ownership, trust and continuous improvement. You’ll have the freedom to make a real impact while working in a collaborative environment with short decision-making lines.

The Opportunity: Senior Site Reliability Engineer

We are growing rapidly and pushing boundaries in secure, cloud-native digital services. We’re seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who thrives on impact and innovation. You’ll be part of a collaborative and diverse team, contributing directly to our SaaS platform built with TypeScript and .NET technologies in a public cloud environment.

At Ockto, you’ll find:

  • A team of smart, friendly colleagues who share knowledge and challenge each other to grow.

What You’ll Do

You’ll work across engineering to continuously improve the reliability, resilience and security of the Ockto platform.

  • Strengthen our cloud security posture and operate the controls behind our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments — IAM, secrets management, hardening, and native tooling such as GuardDuty, Security Hub and CloudTrail.

  • Keep cloud cost efficient, balancing performance and resilience against spend.

  • Drive structured adoption of AI-assisted development workflows (code assistants, automated testing, spec-to-code pipelines).

  • Uphold privacy and ethical standards, recognising the responsibility that comes with managing people’s most personal data.

The Ockto platform enables consumers to securely collect and share personal data: such as identity, income, assets, and spending from trusted sources like government agencies and financial institutions.

title: Senior C/C++ Low Latency Engineer
text:
Your job

This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do!

We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide.

Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples of the ‘everyday’ challenges you would encounter are and have to implement:

  • low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges

  • context-switch-free code

  • design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint

  • data pipelines using a streaming paradigm

  • complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time

  • reimplement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD)

To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results.

In addition to writing code, the Technology team builds and maintains the global (hardware) infrastructure to facilitate the trading. In your job you will be regularly involved in all aspects of the pipeline and different tech stacks; from hardware compositions, network design to data logging pipelines for the traders and quants.


Who are you

Due to the growth of our organization, we are looking for more than one C/C++ Engineer. As the new team member, you bring the following skillset:

  • extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux

  • an understanding of – and the ability to verify - the assembly the compiler will produce from the code you write

  • understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost

  • knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently

  • understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity)

  • ability to work with debuggers and profilers

  • operative coding (git, documentation)

  • ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team

  • pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant

In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have:

  • experience with network engineering; either (low latency) networking hardware deployment or networking protocol implementations;

  • experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases.


What we offer

  • Excellent remuneration (including discretionary bonus)

  • Fun and inspiring work environment

  • Experienced and knowledgeable colleagues

  • 25 vacation days

  • Allowance for commuting expenses

  • Additional benefits

title: Robot Transporter (C Driver)
text:
We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

You’ll transport robots that build houses. You’ll load them at our Amsterdam workshop, get them onto construction sites, and bring them back for repairs before their next job. When a team needs a replacement robot to keep building, you’re the person who gets it there.

We’re hiring our first Robot Transporter. We already have 150+ robots in the field and we’re expanding from the Netherlands into the UK and US. You’ll be the first person dedicated to getting our robots, equipment and materials where they need to be, helping more teams build more homes.

Your day could take you from the workshop to several active construction sites, delivering robots, collecting systems for repair and getting equipment to the next crew. You’ll work out the order of stops, what fits in each vehicle, and how to load and secure it safely. You’ll drive a C-licence box truck or B-licence van, work closely with our deployment team, and get to know the robots and the people building with them.

This is practical, physical work with room to take charge. You’ll start by planning alongside the deployment team, then take ownership of routes and transport requests as you learn the sites and loads. Plans change, sites get muddy, and teams depend on you. You’ll see the houses going up and know you helped get them built.

What you'll do

  • Drive. Operate our leased C-licence box truck and our B-licence van across the Netherlands, usually two or more movements a day. When a move needs a flatbed with forklift loading, you arrange it.

  • Plan the day’s transport. Work with the deployment team on the day’s plan: what goes in which vehicle, and the order of drop-offs and pick-ups across sites, our Groningen hub and our Amsterdam locations. Over time, more of this becomes yours to own.

  • Load and secure. Robots, hoisting cages, scaffolding, inventory kits, equipment. You know weight limits, lashing and what it takes to get a 400+ kg system in and out of a vehicle safely.

title: RF Test Infrastructure Engineer
text:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As an RF Test Infrastructure Engineer, you will be the bridge between our R&D innovations and proven, reliable, hyper-scaled hardware. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on lab role. You won’t just be running routine tests, you will be designing, building, and commissioning the room-temperature (RT) and cryogenic measurement infrastructure required to validate high-density QPUs.

By implementing automated switching matrices and optimizing high-throughput signal lines, your work will directly eliminate the characterization bottleneck, allowing us to de-risk new technologies and scale toward increasingly complex quantum systems.

What You’ll Be Doing

Core Responsibilities

  • Test & Validate Devices: Plan and execute RF and DC test campaigns for VIO™ devices and test vehicles, verifying performance against specifications.

  • Build & Scale Measurement Infrastructure: Bring up, install, operate, and maintain room-temperature and cryogenic measurement setups, scaling them as R&D needs grow.

  • Investigate & Resolve Anomalies: Diagnose test failures, trace root causes, and feed findings back into device and process improvements.

  • Document & Track: Document setups and track process parameters across R&D cycles to build a reusable knowledge base.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Work with a highly interdisciplinary R&D team to align test efforts with development priorities.

  • Own validation end-to-end, from setup and sample integration through execution, analysis, reporting, and recommendations.

  • Lead initiatives to improve test repeatability, measurement standards, and validation scalability.


Your Profile

Must-haves

  • A Master’s degree in electrical engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in test, validation, or characterisation of deep-tech or low-volume hardware (industry experience is a plus).

  • Hands-on experience with RF and/or DC measurement and test methods, and instrumentation such as VNAs and SMUs

  • Direct experience working with high-density interconnects, switching matrices, and evaluating RF link budgets (insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk).

  • Proficiency in Python and data analysis and visualisation for experiments, and for control and measurement electronics.

About you

You’ve built backend systems at high scale and stayed long enough to live with your own decisions, good and bad. You care about how a system is structured, not only the next feature, and you can explain your trade-offs to the people who’ll live with them. Maybe you led a team for a few years and chose to go back to hands-on work. That’s welcome here: this is an individual contributor role, and you’ll write code and touch databases yourself. Our leads spend about 80% of their time hands-on too. You won’t enjoy it if you want to manage people, or if you’d rather stay away from infrastructure and database work.

We’re also hiring Senior Engineers on these teams. If your experience fits Senior better than Staff, we’ll say so openly and talk it through with you.

You have

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including technical leadership on systems in production.

  • Proficiency in Go, Python, or in another backend language plus the willingness to switch to Go.

  • Experience building features used by a large number of users, and scaling them as usage grows.

  • Strong experience with a relational database. We use PostgreSQL, but any relational database counts.

  • Hands-on experience with Redis or a similar in-memory data store.

  • Experience building public APIs or SDKs that other developers use.

  • Comfort with infrastructure and database work as part of your normal week, including Kubernetes.

  • Good written and spoken English. It’s our working language.

Bonus points

  • PostgreSQL in production at scale, including sharding, partitioning or large migrations.

  • Experience improving or redesigning legacy parts of a system that’s serving live traffic.

  • Go and gRPC in production at high request rates.

title: Senior Supply Chain Coordinator
text:
At i3D.net, we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo, and Ubisoft, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.

Waarom jouw rol belangrijk is

Als Senior Supply Chain Coordinator bij i3D.net speel je een belangrijke rol in de succesvolle realisatie van onze infrastructuurprojecten in Nederland. Je zorgt ervoor dat inkoop, leveranciersrelaties, contractmanagement en financiële beheersing goed op elkaar aansluiten, zodat complexe projecten volgens planning verlopen.

Je opereert op het snijvlak van Supply Chain, Data Center Operations, Finance, technische teams en Legal. Daarbij ben je verantwoordelijk voor de commerciële en contractuele aspecten van infrastructuurprojecten. Van het begeleiden van aanbestedingen en onderhandelen over contracten tot het beheren van contractwijzigingen, meer- en minderwerk, claims en kosten tijdens de uitvoering: jij zorgt voor structuur, overzicht en grip op het proces.

Met jouw werk heb je directe invloed op projectplanningen, kostenbeheersing en de succesvolle uitbreiding van de infrastructuur van i3D.net.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Aanbestedingen en inkoop: Je begeleidt het volledige aanbestedings- en inkoopproces voor infrastructuurprojecten, waaronder het opstellen en uitzetten van offerteaanvragen (RFQ's), het vergelijken en beoordelen van aanbiedingen, het selecteren van aannemers en het voeren van commerciële onderhandelingen.

  • Contractmanagement: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van contracten gedurende de volledige projectcyclus. Van de eerste onderhandelingen en contractafspraken tot het afhandelen van contractwijzigingen, meer- en minderwerk en claims tijdens de uitvoering.

  • Leveranciers- en aannemersmanagement: Je bouwt en onderhoudt sterke relaties met aannemers, leveranciers en andere externe partners. Je bewaakt contractuele afspraken, kwaliteitsnormen en oplevertermijnen.

  • Ondersteuning van infrastructuurprojecten: Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt vanuit Supply Chain voor de uitvoering van infrastructuurprojecten in Nederland en werkt nauw samen met datacenter-, technische en projectteams.

  • Kostenbeheersing en rapportages: Je bewaakt financiële verplichtingen, uitgaven en contractwaarden. Met jouw gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden zorg je voor betrouwbare financiële inzichten en signaleer je tijdig mogelijke risico's.

  • Contractmanagementsystemen: Je ondersteunt bij de selectie, implementatie en ingebruikname van een Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)-systeem binnen de Supply Chain-afdeling.

  • Samenwerking met stakeholders: Je werkt nauw samen met Finance, Legal, technische teams en externe aannemers om projecten soepel te laten verlopen en besluitvorming te ondersteunen.

title: Corporate Development Director
Senior Backend Engineer, AI Platform (Toqan)
text:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Toqan is Prosus's internal AI platform — the infrastructure and tooling layer that powers agentic AI-driven products across the entire group.We are building secure, configurable agent runtimes that can operate reliably at scale across different products, channels and use cases..  

You’ll work where distributed systems meet applied AI: orchestrating models and tools, enabling agents to perform long-running work, and turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into dependable platform primitives. The challenges span asynchronous workflows, isolated execution, extensible integrations, reliability, observability and cost control.

The Toqan platform serves the whole Prosus portfolio and other connected businesses, which means the backend systems you build here have reach far beyond a single team. You'll join a 12-person engineering team in Amsterdam and work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to ship end-to-end — at pace, without compromising quality.

Who You Are

You are a senior backend engineer who has moved well past following patterns and into setting them. You're comfortable owning architectural decisions on novel infrastructure — the kind where the right answer isn't obvious and the stakes are real. You think in systems, spot failure modes early, and hold a high bar for production quality without letting perfect block good. The 80/20 mindset comes naturally: you know when to go deep and when to ship.

You've likely come from a startup or high-velocity environment where shipping fast wasn't a culture slogan — it was survival. You know how to cut scope without cutting corners, move from zero to production without a safety net, and iterate quickly on systems that are still finding their shape.

You're genuinely curious about the AI and LLM space — not as a trend to track, but as a domain where you've already done hands-on integration work and want to go further. AI tools aren't an afterthought in how you work — you use them daily, whether that's Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex, and you've developed real judgment about where they accelerate work and where they don't. You operate with low ego, share context freely, and thrive in an environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down — it's where you do your best work.
